description: This file defines a database migration class for Android, specifically handling the transition between database versions 10 and 11. It modifies user preference settings related to dark mode by changing boolean preferences to string-based enum representations (`DarkModeSetting`). The class interacts with shared preferences to update theme settings during migration.

classes.name: Migration_10_11
classes.description: A subclass of Room's Migration class to handle schema and data changes when upgrading the database from version 10 to 11, specifically migrating dark theme preferences to use a string representation.

methods.name: Migration_10_11
methods.description: Constructor that sets the start and end database versions and initializes the context used for accessing shared preferences.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Overrides the migrate method to implement the logic for updating user preferences related to dark mode to a new enum-based system during database migration.
